description: This is a PHPUnit test file for the ModuleDao class within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It contains test cases for retrieving, updating, and listing modules and their statuses, specifically testing the ModuleDao's methods.

classes.name: ModuleDaoTest
classes.description: Test suite for the ModuleDao class, testing module retrieval, updating statuses, and listing disabled modules.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes ModuleDao instance and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testGetModuleList
methods.description: Verifies that getModuleList retrieves the correct number of Module instances with expected properties.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatus
methods.description: Checks if updateModuleStatus correctly updates module statuses in the database.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatusForReturnedValues
methods.description: Ensures updateModuleStatus returns the correct list of Module objects with updated statuses.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatusWithModulesDoesNotExists
methods.description: Tests behavior when updating module statuses with a module that doesn't exist.

methods.name: testDisabledModuleList
methods.description: Confirms that getDisabledModuleList correctly lists disabled modules.
